description: Ensuring the structural stability of the laboratory buildings of the National Institute of Fundamental Studies affected by the Cyclone 'Ditwah'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Institute of Fundamental Studies, established by the National Institute of Fundamental Studies Act, No.55 of 1981, is a premier nationallevel research institute conducting fundamental scientific research in Sri Lanka and making a significant contribution to human capital development. Due to the heavy rainfall accompanying the Cyclone 'Ditwah' that affected the island in November 2025, a landslide occurred in and around the premises of the National Institute of Fundamental Studies located in Hanthana, Kandy. As a result, the structural stability of the main laboratory building complex of the institute has been severely threatened, and there is also a serious risk to the safety of the lives and properties of the adjacent residents. After conducting the relevant geotechnical and structural assessments, the National Building Research Institute has recommended that reconstruction work, including the construction of a protective embankment, be implemented urgently to stabilize the damaged area. The cost for the said work is estimated as Rs.250 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology to transfer the responsibility of managing the design, geotechnical evaluation and procurement process of the relevant project to the National Building Research Institute on a direct contract basis, was approved by the Cabinet.
